title: kaiak usage totals
description: The control plane's usage totals as one gateway gets them: the data of a totals event on that gateway's stream, and part of every usage ack it gets. A consistent snapshot: its windows include every batch the control plane had counted when it took the revision, and no other. Complete: it lists every hour and month limit window with usage in the control plane's current window; a limit it does not list has used nothing there. Per-minute limits are not listed (each gateway enforces its share locally).

revision.description: Orders totals messages: a gateway applies one only when it is newer than the last applied — the same control plane and a higher sequence, or another control plane (a restarted one).

config_epoch.description: The epoch of the store the config version counts in (config-snapshot.schema.json). With config_version, the config the totals were computed under: a gateway applies the totals only when both equal its applied config's.

config_version.description: The config version whose limits the totals were computed under.

live_gateways.description: Gateways in the live set. Each divides its per-minute limits by this count (at least 1), and enforces its share of every backend max_in_flight cap: ceil(max_in_flight / live_gateways), at least 1.

counted_through.description: The last usage batch the control plane has counted for the recipient gateway's instance (the stream's, or the acknowledged batch's); null before its first. Included in the windows: the gateway stops counting that batch and every earlier one of the epoch as its own.

control_plane.description: Random, 128 bits, lowercase hex; created when the control-plane process starts.

sequence.description: Increases with every change to the totals in that process (a counted batch, a publish, a change to the live set).

batch_position.description: A batch within its gateway's epochs: the epoch and the sequence (usage-batch.schema.json, batch_id).

window.description: One limit's current window: the limit's identity (group or global, type, model set — as in config), the window start and the amount used.

group.description: The group the limit belongs to. Absent for a global limit.

type.description: Limit types counted by the control plane: fixed UTC hours and calendar months.

models.description: The limit's model set, order ignored. Omitted = the limit covers all models.

window_start.description: Start of the window, UTC: the top of an hour for tokens_per_hour, the first of a month for usd_per_month.

used.description: tokens_per_hour: tokens (tokens_in + tokens_cached + tokens_out); usd_per_month: nano-USD.
